status: Status: frozen for W1 (ADR-0252). Assigned IDs and numbers are immutable; a change is a new ID (ADR-0165, C-43, C-44).
rules: A media profile ID is the value of ExpressiveAssetRef.media_profile_id. An ID this registry does not list is wire-valid and the asset renders as its inert placeholder with alt_text (EXPRESSIVE_MEDIA_CONTENT_PACKS_AND_ENTITLEMENTS.md, security invariant 5).

A resource profile bounds an asset's declared and container facts. The resource profile of an asset follows from its kind (kind_resource_profile); a reaction_asset uses the stricter custom-emoji.v1 (ADR-0252 rule 3).

Every figure is the design ceiling or the ADR-0251 budget; nothing here lowers a ceiling the design states. A change that rejects more is a new profile or budget ID; one that admits more needs an ADR because it changes fallback validity (C-44).

Capability IDs are carried in DeviceCredential key 8 (capabilities, a set of text strings of at most 64 bytes). A sender emits a reserved W1 slot only when every recipient device advertises both the slot capability and the media profile of the asset (ADR-0128 rule 18). The two slot capabilities are also the required_capabilities entry of an event that uses the slot.
Text limits are in Unicode scalar values where the design states characters; the wire bound is four times that in bytes. Text is never normalized.
